reviews.title: It won’t let me cancel
reviews.text: Every time I try to go to settings and cancel it says user doesn’t exist. It charged my credit card just fine but it doesn’t show up in my list of subscriptions that I can cancel. I should have never started a free trial because the app is difficult to use and I hate it and now I can’t cancel it

reviews.title: Gets worse every year
reviews.text: This app just keeps going downhill and the website is just following suit. The app constantly logs me out. Making ride plans on the app is a nightmare. Selecting a trail is hit or miss if you get any information. And lately when I creat a ride plan if I share it with my friends they get a chain of red text and no route. Too bad. Used to be worth the premium membership I’ll be canceling mine.

reviews.title: Can’t Edit Profile
reviews.text: I have attempted 5x to edit my profile…add photo, change demographics, add birthdate, etc. and it will not update after I hit save. I’ve deleted and started a new account. I’ve deleted the app and reinstalled it and the app is updated. Won’t be staying after the free trial of pro is done.

reviews.title: The app is only good for recording that is about it.

reviews.title: Useless unless you pay

reviews.title: Is this a dead app?
reviews.text: I accidentally let my free trial expire and now have the full app for a year and I can’t see what’s different from the free version. Within 40 miles only 5 trails are on the map despite there actually being thousands and the last trail report was from 2020. Strands free version is better then Trailforks paid version for sure

reviews.title: Pay version no better than free
reviews.text: Pay version no better than free. Compared to Gaia GPS, this is an epic fail. Shame.

reviews.title: Useful, but too many popups
reviews.text:
We use this app for work every day, and there’s no need for us to have trailforks pro, if we wanted it, we’d get it and it’s annoying to click the ad away EVERY time we want to see our worksite. 

MTB Project offers the same features for free, we may go to using that app soon.

reviews.title: Many Good Features, One Big Flaw
reviews.text:
This app features many excellent trail discovery features but I find it extremely difficult to use. Too many times I can’t do the things I want in the app itself and find myself having to go to the website to do things like building my own route.

Also one major issue with the AppleWatch app, it does not support native Always-On rendering! When looking at your metrics or the map to see when the next turn is coming up, it always takes a second or two to come out of low power mode. This is not safe! A lot can happen in those few seconds. Apps like WorkOutDoors do not have this flaw.

reviews.title: Shady business practice
reviews.text: Trailforks used to be a great app even if you used the free version. So much so that everyone started to use it and it was THE option for adding and finding trails. Then they completely gutted the free version of the app and made it unusable. They increased their prices a bunch as well. Seems real shady

reviews.title: 0 customer support
reviews.text: This is indeed my favorite mtb app out there, I've been using it for years.  It's great, until you have a problem!  Recently my app stopped working and saying "user has been deactivated" when I try to login. I have tried everything to login or reset my account, even tried to set up a new account which gave me a different error. I have reached out multiple times on 3 separate occasions for assistance from customer support. I receive an email with a ticket number indicating that they have received my request and will be in contact soon. I never receive any follow ups. I have reached out multiple times and always receive the confirmation email but never ANY support or solutions. If quality customer service is important to you I would look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Navigation sucks
reviews.text: I wanted an Apple Watch app that had a map function to help navigate new trails.  This failed.  No turn by turn alerts or instructions during routes.  No audible or haptic notifications for upcoming turns or notifications for being off route.  Frustrating to say the least!

reviews.title: What have you done?
reviews.text: It keeps asking me to pay for a subscription every time I zoom in to see the MTB trails. Not the best I have to use ride pal now.

reviews.title: Money grab
reviews.text: Okay I am about to straight up delete this app. I made an account, but app is unusable without paying a subscription. Part get shaved away more and mor over time. Now you can’t see elevation profile or even use the search bar.

reviews.title: Useless

If you try to use it with a bike computer like a garmin edge it wont synch.  When you subscribe it constantly asks you to “renew” your subscription and even then it still does not give you the pro features.

You guys ever wonder why AllTrails has over a million downloads? Because you can actually SEE useful information WITHOUT having to pay! Plus the paid version is cheaper! Get a clue…

reviews.title: Useless without a paid subscription
reviews.text: I used the app for years and contributed to trail logs etc. When they started charging I thought, ok, paid for a subscription for a year. It wasn’t that worth it considering the information is crowdsourced and the app is never updated and buggy. It expired and I’m so disappointed with the free version. They make it totally useless. Can’t see any details and a pop up trying to get you to subscribe every five seconds. I’m switching to MTB Project and you should too!

reviews.title: Terrible UI
reviews.text: The concept is great and they have incorporated many of the logical features one would expect, but the app has a completely convoluted user interface making access to the features complicated. The desktop and mobile apps are so different. You can’t even find core features. Something as simple as just building a route requires constant referencing of tutorials. Saved routes don’t sync properly between devices.

reviews.title: What for?
reviews.text: No use if ur in Scotland👎🏼

reviews.title: Stuck icon
reviews.text: I have had a pro subscription for 4 years. Out of nowhere the icon ( gps triangle) that literally tells you where you are going, is stuck. I kinda knew where I was but it could’ve been bad. The temps were 8° today. I have used this for trail systems in five states. Literally planned lodging ,adventures camping everything all going off of this app. Then one day in the brutal winter, it just stopped working. I’m really hoping tech-support gets back to me. I don’t want to have to go with one of apps. I did all of their suggested troubleshooting. And all permissions were allowed so I don’t know what’s up.

reviews.title: Old, outdated, useless
reviews.text: It’s sad that it doesn’t list any new trails. I had many new trails on my local and it’s not shown. Strava shows the trails but this thing doesn’t. Apparently the trail should be approved by admins, and only god knows who the admins. It tracks via GPS and if 100s of people are riding down a trail then there must be a trail. Paid for premium for this and it’s the worst app ever. I am going to cancel the subscription and get Strava

reviews.title: Unending glitches
reviews.text: I have Trailforks Pro, and the app can’t seem to remember that I have Pro and is constantly asking me to upgrade. The yellow upgrade to pro sign on the map never goes away even though I’ve paid for it. Plus I needed to use this when I was out of service and because the app doesn’t remember that I have Pro, it wouldn’t let me look at the offline maps that I had downloaded. I had to reconnect to cellular then load the maps to see them. Such a pain. I definitely won’t be renewing my subscription unless this gets fixed.
